---
title: "Photo Gallery"
lightbox: true
---

Welcome to my photo gallery! Click on any image to expand it.

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
import os
from PIL import Image

image_folder = "images"

# Find all image files in the directory
images = [f for f in os.listdir(image_folder) if f.lower().endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))]
images.sort()

horizontal_images = []
vertical_images = []

# Check dimensions and separate into lists
for img in images:
    file_path = os.path.join(image_folder, img)
    try:
        # Open the image to check its size
        with Image.open(file_path) as i:
            width, height = i.size
            if width >= height:
                horizontal_images.append(img)
            else:
                vertical_images.append(img)
    except Exception as e:
        # Skip if the file can't be read as an image
        pass

# --- Print Horizontal Images ---
if horizontal_images:
#    print("### Landscape\n")
    # 2 columns for horizontal keeps them wide enough to see
    print("::: {layout-ncol=2}\n")
    for img in horizontal_images:
        caption = img.rsplit('.', 1)[0].replace('-', ' ').replace('_', ' ').title()
        file_path = f"{image_folder}/{img}"
        print(f"![{caption}]({file_path}){{group=\"auto-gallery\"}}\n")
    print(":::\n")

# --- Print Vertical Images ---
if vertical_images:
#    print("### Portrait\n")
    # 2 columns for vertical makes them smaller so they fit the page better
    print("::: {layout-ncol=2}\n")
    for img in vertical_images:
        caption = img.rsplit('.', 1)[0].replace('-', ' ').replace('_', ' ').title()
        file_path = f"{image_folder}/{img}"
        print(f"![{caption}]({file_path}){{group=\"auto-gallery\"}}\n")
    print(":::\n")
```
